**Independent QA: changes required — communication only.**

Remove the final PR-body sentence, “Independent review/QA remains pending.” This assessment is complete; the supplied PR standard requires current review status. The same QA can recheck the revised body and full feedback without rerunning unchanged tests.

Code, scope and behavior gates pass at `ea87b78e` against master `1f032905`: all 21 paths/one commit reviewed, exact request/preset recaptures match, six focused tests pass, and source-free ESM plus client-bundle boundaries verify. No product defect found. Docker execution remains unperformed because its engine is unavailable; the unchanged packaging contract and relocated runtime were checked. The bot's quota refusal is not a completed bot review.

[Immutable findings, complete scope, evidence and revision/body bindings](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/0ddde9ab71f326cfae3b0b261baabb64f149768f/qa-verdict.json) · [Readable evidence summary](https://github.com/MChartier/little-say/blob/0ddde9ab71f326cfae3b0b261baabb64f149768f/README.md).
